dependency_rationale: Report-event mapping cardinality cannot be assessed until the event-unit construct itself (R-O1) is computable.
Parent-episode membership correctness presupposes a resolved definition of what one event is.
The primary-set dedup-cleanliness question (is this row a duplicate event) presupposes a resolved event-unit construct.
Interval-bound construction per event presupposes the event being bounded is itself well-defined.
Literal source-term to project-category mapping (R-O7) requires the actor/action/outcome layer (R-O6) to know what, specifically, a category label is describing.

Exposure-candidate validity (R-O9) depends on observation/survival/access process readiness (R-O8); an exposure measure cannot be judged externally valid while the processes generating the underlying archival counts are themselves unresolved.
Comparator feasibility (R-O10, O-component) requires event-unit ontology compatibility.
Comparator feasibility (R-O10, T-component) requires usable date semantics.
Comparator feasibility depends indirectly on observation-process readiness via R-O9.
Comparator feasibility (R-O10, E-component) requires a non-circular exposure candidate.
Reconsideration gate requires the source-criticism compound gate to hold.
Reconsideration gate requires the ontology compound gate to hold.

DEDUP-06's resolvability is bounded by parent-episode/dedup-audit evidence quality (R-O3 correctness); grounded in HAWKES_BASELINE_V2_DUPLICATE_CORROBORATION_RELATIONS.csv's dedup06_* columns sitting alongside parent_episode_id assignments.

M_report component of G_ontology is defined directly on R-O2's genuine report-event relation; grounded in the gate matrix's G_ontology_future row (M_report traces to R-O2's demonstrably absent schema field).
M_coding/M_source components of G_ontology trace to R-O7's unmapped colonial categories; grounded in the same gate matrix row.
G_sourcecrit's gate_indicator=0 is directly and solely attributed to R-O7's incomplete mapping (0/5 categories) in the source gate matrix's own evidence_summary.
G_reconsider's definition (Section 20 of the governing instruction) requires Q_R-O1..Q_R-O10 all PASS; R-O10 is therefore a direct, not only indirect, input.
